handoffs.message: Ready for review. Evidence: cron.list total=72 (68 real jobs for the 17 existing personas, all present, 0 missing; +4 pre-existing orphan jobs for a non-existent test persona 'persona-diag-local-4' not in the current agent list -- likely residue from OPENCLAW-CRON-WRITE-SCOPE's live full-BFF-path verification. Their removal was blocked by the harness permission classifier as pre-existing jobs I did not create this session; recommend a human/ops-authorized cron.remove for those 4 ids, or a tiny follow-up task -- they are NOT part of this task's 17-persona acceptance and do not indicate any backfill gap). sessionTarget: gateway persists 'main' regardless of submitted value (confirmed via cron.list samples + force-run sessionKey agent:main:cron:...); this is the same gateway-normalization finding already folded into OPENCLAW-OODA-PACKET-CLOSURE, not a new open question. Force-run: persona-tw-equity and persona-crypto ingest jobs both -> cron.runs status ok. Idempotency: reran reconcile_persona_ooda_cron.py twice after fixing 2 registrar bugs (job_name truncation collision + cron.list limit=500/silent-swallow) -> registered=0 skipped=68 failed=0 both times. Also note: while diagnosing the limit=500 bug I twice accidentally created real duplicate jobs (46 then 36) before catching it -- both times identified via job-id-set diffing against a pre-change snapshot and removed; final gateway state verified to match the original 72-job snapshot exactly (same ids) before the idempotent reruns. Commit 05f51918e, PR https://github.com/ajoe734/pantheon/pull/2985 (auto-merge enabled against dev). Tests: python3 -m pytest services/control-plane/cron/ -q -> 39 passed.

Chair reassigned review from Codex to Claude2: codex1 (agent Codex) has been quota_terminal dispatch-paused since 2026-07-04T15:49:09Z ('Codex usage limit reached'), ~49 minutes elapsed as of this review (16:38Z), past the 30-minute reviewer-reassignment threshold and still active (blocked_until ~16:49Z). Claude2 shares Claude's governance-review/control-plane capability lane, is idle (0 active tasks), auth_ready=true, and is not itself dispatch-paused or the task owner.
